mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 5% indicates tighter monetary conditions, which increases borrowing costs and reduces consumer and business spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a strong labor market and increased consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in > 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 100,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases, it signals a strong labor market and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in > 50% of instances when PAYEMS increases > 100k and UNRATE decreases, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 3% year-over-year signals strong economic activity and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in > 40% of instances when INDPRO growth > 3% YoY, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a 0.5% increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals higher borrowing costs and reduced economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 50% of tightening instances, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When both GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) increase, it signals strong economic demand and construction activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in > 50% of instances when GDPC1 and HOUST both increase, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in retail sales (RSAFS) above $700 million signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in > 40% of instances when RSAFS > $700 million, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a rise in CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 300 signals inflation concerns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of late-cycle instances when CPIAUCSL > 300, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year window.
